title: THE CORNER CREDITS STAY PUT OVER A CARD WINDOW
why: Found by the code review of 2026-10-08: v19.73 moved the CREDITS and XP readout down to the heading row whenever any window was open, but the centred card windows (PARTY, TERMS, the gambler, the bar) have no heading row up there, and at 4K the move put the figures on the PARTY frame top line. Over those cards the readout keeps its corner place; over the full windows it still sits on the heading row.
now: With the PARTY window open at 4K, the corner credits no longer sit on its frame.
